translations.translatedText: # Saturday 20.7.2019 (radio)

Iran stopped a British tanker. The trial in a big drug case began. The citizens' initiative for therapy guarantee is moving on to Parliament. Honey harvest may be small. The number of boat registrations increased.
![Stena Impero tanker](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10887065)
Open image viewer
The Stena Impero tanker, which Iran has stopped. Photo: Tommy Chia / Stena Bulk / EPA
## Iran stopped a British tanker

Iran has stopped a British oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran stopped the tanker on Friday. The tanker has a crew of 23. Britain is worried about the matter. Britain says that British ships must now avoid the Strait of Hormuz.
Relations between Britain and Iran are difficult. In early July Britain stopped an Iranian tanker at Gibraltar. Britain has not let it continue its journey. Now Iran has stopped a British tanker.
## Trial in a big drug case begins
![Helsinki police, Pasila police station](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10887174)
Open image viewer
The hearing was on Saturday at the Pasila police station in Helsinki. Photo: Jouni Immonen / Yle

The Helsinki District Court has dealt with a big drug case on Saturday. The district court placed one man in custody, who may be the leader of the Hells Angels criminal gang in Finland. The man is suspected of aggravated drug crime.
The police say that the case is a big one. Many people and a lot of drugs are involved in it. The police will not yet say more about the case. The hearing on Saturday was not public.
## Therapy guarantee will be discussed in Parliament
![A demonstration for the therapy guarantee in front of the House of Estates in May.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10784201)
Open image viewer
People demonstrated in front of the House of Estates in May in support of the therapy guarantee. Photo: Jouni Immonen / Yle

The citizens' initiative on the therapy guarantee for mental health services is moving on to Parliament. The citizens' initiative has received more than 50,000 names, which are needed for Parliament to discuss the initiative.

The therapy guarantee initiative proposes changes to the Mental Health Act and the Health Care Act. The initiative wants people to be able to get help for mental health problems more quickly from health centres.
## Bees are having a bad summer
![bee](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9723128)
Open image viewer
Many plants that are important to bees have done badly, because the summer has been cold. Photo: Jussi Mankkinen / Yle
The honey harvest may be small. Many flowers that are important to bees have not grown well this summer.

Beekeepers say that the bees are also swarming a lot this year. Swarming means that a large part of the bees in a hive leave to make a new hive somewhere else. The apiary is then left with fewer bees.
## Boat sales grew
![A large boat in a harbour.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-7374009)
Open image viewer
The most boats were registered in Uusimaa and Southwest Finland. Photo: Petri Aaltonen / Yle
Sales of new boats have increased. New boats and jet skis were entered in the register 11% more in early in the year than last year in January–June.
The most registered were motor boats. The popularity of jet skis also grew.
